comment: Independent C-first p_type 0 caller variation. A neutral Barbarian starts on a wished lawful altar with uncursed water on the floor. The first prayer should take p_type 2 and change that bottle to cursed water; its prayer delay makes the immediate second prayer p_type 0, so prayer_done invokes water_prayer(FALSE) again before the too-soon penalties. This checks the p_type 0 caller even though the second call has no water state left to change. Seed, date, name, and role were chosen independently.
